audit.label: Perceptual salience

audit.label: Goal relevance

audit.label: Attentional set / target template

audit.label: Executive attentional control
audit.measurement_route: executive-control/competition-resolution task

audit.label: Reward-associated attentional priority
audit.measurement_route: value-driven attentional-capture paradigm with prior reward association

audit.label: Prior-selection history

audit.label: Vigilance decrement
